source_quote:
You should add case into https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/.github/workflows/configs/nightly_config.yaml
The model should be added into https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/.github/workflows/misc/model_dataset_list.json if it is new， and we will download it in ci.
`npu_per_node` should be 16 if you use A3；

rule.description: 新增的 e2e 测试配置文件必须注册到 nightly_config.yaml 中，新模型必须添加到 model_dataset_list.json 以便 CI 自动下载。硬件相关的配置参数（如 npu_per_node）必须与硬件规格匹配。
checkpoints: 新增测试 yaml 是否已注册到 nightly_config.yaml
新模型是否已添加到 model_dataset_list.json
npu_per_node 等硬件参数是否与目标硬件匹配（如 A3 应为 16）

antipattern.code:
# Nightly test configuration for vllm-ascend
# Each entry maps a test config to its CI parameters

test_suites:
  - name: multi-node-DSV4-Flash-pd
    config_file: tests/e2e/nightly/multi_node/internal_dp/config/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W8A8-A3-pd.yaml
    hardware: A3
    timeout: 120

  - name: multi-node-Qwen-disagg-pd
    config_file: tests/e2e/nightly/multi_node/internal_dp/config/Qwen-Disagg-PD.yaml
    hardware: A3
    timeout: 90
  # DeepSeek-V4-Flash recompute-cpu-offload 测试未注册
